$comment: One fingerprint per spec corpus document: a 16-hex digest of the parseJson tree under sorted keys, then the node types it holds with a count where there is more than one. It exists because the two aggregate checks in tests/corpus.mjs pass as long as every type appears SOMEWHERE - a greedy cover of the 58 produced types needs 18 documents, so 1722 of 1740 could return an empty tree and stay green (markup-carve/carve-wasm#139). This records what the engine produces today rather than what it should produce; the parts of the tree that CAN be derived are checked in tests/corpus.mjs instead, where every tree has to render as its source does and every position has to agree with the source it indexes. Regenerate with UPDATE_AST_LEDGER=1 node --stack-size=4000 tests/corpus.mjs, and say in the commit message which upstream change moved the trees.
